Format
vCard (.vcf)
Opens in almost every contacts app, with photos
Encrypted vCard
A vCard locked with a passphrase you choose. Parley opens it on any phone; the format is documented for other apps
Your notes as text (.txt)
Notes for calls, call notes and Circle moments, person by person
What goes in
Include private contacts
Off: only contacts other apps can see
This file isn\'t encrypted: anyone who gets it can read your private contacts. Keep it somewhere safe, or choose Encrypted vCard.
Include your notes
Notes for calls, call notes, Circle moments and promises, kept beside each card. Parley reads them back from an encrypted vCard
CSV has no place for notes: choose vCard to keep them
Passphrase for this file
Parley can\'t recover it: without the passphrase nobody can open the file, you included.
Choose where to save
Nothing was saved: Parley closed while you chose the place. Type the passphrase again, then choose where to save.

Your notes folder no longer updates
Export contacts now exports your notes, as a file whenever you choose. What is already in the folder stays there.
Export contacts and notes
vCard, encrypted vCard or CSV, with private contacts and your notes when you choose
export, vcard, vcf, csv, notes, markdown, obsidian, private, encrypted, passphrase, text
What a backup holds

Contacts and private contacts with their photos, call history, blocking, speed dial, settings, your notes and Circle, family safe words, helpers and expected calls, the drive and abroad switches, and ringtones made from a name.

Stays on this phone: History & undo and Snapshots (this phone\'s own record of changes, which would only mix things up on another), what Parley learned from calls (spam guesses, call quality: it learns again), the cars of the drive profile (pair them again), and your PIN and keys (set up again on the new phone).
